description:
Title: Farming Bot

Players want to create custom farming bots, that help them gather resources.
First you have to find out which resources you want.
Up to 10 resources in parallel can be collected, some resources are more urgently needed than others.
Some resources are required to create tools that are needed to gather other resources (create a custom logic of the dependencies in your game).
After all preferences are collected, your bot starts farming.
Sometimes,  random natural disasters strike and set your bot back.
Whenever some milestones are reached, you are notified.
During farming it is possible to update the list of to be farmed materials (at all times).
After the bot is finished, you should be able to brag to selected friends and/or send them materials.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_FarmingBot" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Preferences" name="Preferences submitted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Milestone" name="Milestone reached"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_BotFinished" name="Bot finished"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_UpdateRequest" name="Material list update requested"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_MaterialUpdate" name="Updated material list"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Brag" name="Brag to friends"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Materials" name="Materials sent"/>
  <bpmn:signal id="Sig_Disaster" name="Natural disaster strikes"/>
  <bpmn:signal id="Sig_Milestone" name="Milestone reached"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_FarmingBot">
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Player" name="Player" processRef="Process_Player"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Bot" name="Farming Bot" processRef="Process_Bot"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Preferences" name="Preferences" sourceRef="Task_SendPreferences" targetRef="Start_Preferences"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Milestone" name="Milestone notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="Catch_Milestone"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_BotFinished" name="Bot finished" sourceRef="Task_NotifyFinished" targetRef="Catch_BotFinished"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_MaterialUpdate" name="Updated material list" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdate" targetRef="Start_MaterialUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Brag" name="Brag" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Part_Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_SendMaterials" name="Materials" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Part_Friends"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Player" name="Player Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CreateBot" name="Bot creation started"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectResources" name="Select resources to farm (max. 10)"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetUrgency" name="Set resource urgency"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPreferences" name="Send preferences to bot" messageRef="Msg_Preferences"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Monitor_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_Monitor_Events"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Milestone" name="Milestone reached">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Catch_Milestone" messageRef="Msg_Milestone"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewMilestone" name="Review milestone notification"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_BotFinished" name="Bot finished">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Catch_BotFinished" messageRef="Msg_BotFinished"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Share_Split" name="Share with friends"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends" messageRef="Msg_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends" messageRef="Msg_Materials"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Sharing" name="Sharing completed"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_UpdateList" name="Update material list during farming" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_UpdateRequest" name="Update requested" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Start_UpdateRequest" messageRef="Msg_UpdateRequest"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateList" name="Update material list"/>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendUpdate" name="Send updated material list to bot" messageRef="Msg_MaterialUpdate"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_UpdateList" name="List updated"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateStart" sourceRef="Start_UpdateRequest" targetRef="Task_UpdateList"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateSend" sourceRef="Task_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_SendUpdate"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdate" targetRef="End_UpdateList"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P1" sourceRef="Start_CreateBot" targetRef="Task_SelectResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P2" sourceRef="Task_SelectResources" targetRef="Task_SetUrgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P3" sourceRef="Task_SetUrgency" targetRef="Task_SendPreferences"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P4" sourceRef="Task_SendPreferences" targetRef="Gateway_Monitor_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P5" sourceRef="Gateway_Monitor_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Monitor_Events"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P6" sourceRef="Gateway_Monitor_Events" targetRef="Catch_Milestone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P7" sourceRef="Gateway_Monitor_Events" targetRef="Catch_BotFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P8" sourceRef="Catch_Milestone" targetRef="Task_ReviewMilestone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P9" sourceRef="Task_ReviewMilestone" targetRef="Gateway_Monitor_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P10" sourceRef="Catch_BotFinished" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P11" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Split" targetRef="Task_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P12" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Split" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P13" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P14" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P15" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Join" targetRef="End_Sharing"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Bot" name="Farming Bot Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Preferences" name="Preferences received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Start_Preferences" messageRef="Msg_Preferences"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:businessRuleTask id="Task_ResolveDependencies" name="Resolve tool dependencies for resources"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Farm_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Farm" name="Farm selected resources"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_Disaster" name="Natural disaster strikes" attachedToRef="Task_Farm" cancelActivity="true">
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SED_Disaster" signalRef="Sig_Disaster"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Recover" name="Recover from natural disaster"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyFinished" name="Notify player bot is finished" messageRef="Msg_BotFinished"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Farming" name="Farming finished"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Milestone" name="Notify milestones" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Milestone" name="Milestone reached" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SED_Start_Milestone" signalRef="Sig_Milestone"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of milestone" messageRef="Msg_Milestone"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Milestone" name="Player notified"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MS1" sourceRef="Start_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MS2" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="End_Milestone"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_UpdateFarming" name="Apply material list update" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_MaterialUpdate" name="Updated material list received" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Start_MaterialUpdate" messageRef="Msg_MaterialUpdate"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ApplyUpdate" name="Update farming list"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ApplyUpdate" name="Farming list updated"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UP1" sourceRef="Start_MaterialUpdate" targetRef="Task_ApplyUpdate"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UP2" sourceRef="Task_ApplyUpdate" targetRef="End_ApplyUpdate"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B1" sourceRef="Start_Preferences" targetRef="Task_ResolveDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B2" sourceRef="Task_ResolveDependencies" targetRef="Gateway_Farm_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B3" sourceRef="Gateway_Farm_Merge" targetRef="Task_Farm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B4" sourceRef="Task_Farm" targetRef="Task_NotifyFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B5" sourceRef="Task_NotifyFinished" targetRef="End_Farming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B6" sourceRef="Boundary_Disaster" targetRef="Task_Recover"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B7" sourceRef="Task_Recover" targetRef="Gateway_Farm_Merge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
